name: PRIVA
recent: Privasia Technology Berhad 于 2026 年 10 月 5 日签署了一份谅解备忘录（MOU）。新闻显示其子公司获得 Miti 批准数据中心项目，并有关于智能港口物流的报道。最新财报（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度）显示营收和净利均环比及同比大幅增长。
notable: 签署了一份谅解备忘录（MOU）。

recent_en: Privasia Technology Berhad signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on 5 October 2026. News reports indicate its unit received Miti approval for a data centre project, along with coverage on smart port logistics. The latest financial results (quarter ended 30 June 2026) show significant growth in revenue and net profit both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year.
notable_en: Unit received Miti approval for a data centre project.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 50.27 million, up 77.6% QoQ and 21.3% YoY; net profit was MYR 1.13 million, up 67.6% QoQ and 181.2% YoY; net margin was 2.2% versus 2.4% in the previous quarter.
